d:
Operation Safed Sagar is Netflix's new war drama series based on the 1999 Kargil War, following the legendary Golden Arrows Squadron of the Indian Air Force and their high-altitude aerial combat missions. The series stars Siddharth, Jimmy Shergill, Abhay Verma, Mihir Ahuja, Dia Mirza and others.
In this episode of First Cut, Dabeet Singh reviews Operation Safed Sagar and breaks down whether Netflix has finally cracked the code for an Indian war series with Top Gun-style aerial combat.
